description: Golden test cases verifying Regional Scoping (Spec Rule 1: A document may be used only if its region is Global or the user's region)

testCases.title: Americas Employee accesses Americas Travel Policy (D-001)
testCases.description: Americas user queries meal allowance; D-001 is Approved, Region: Americas, Audience: All Staff.
testCases.question: What is my daily meal allowance when I travel?

testCases.title: Americas Employee queries receipt threshold in Americas (D-001)
testCases.description: Americas user asks about receipt threshold for travel expenses.
testCases.question: What is the daily meal allowance when I travel?

testCases.title: EMEA Employee accesses EMEA Travel Policy (D-002)
testCases.description: EMEA user queries meal allowance; D-002 is Approved, Region: EMEA, Audience: All Staff. Must cite D-002 and state EUR 60.
testCases.question: What is my daily meal allowance when I travel?

testCases.title: EMEA user queries receipt threshold in EMEA (D-002)
testCases.description: EMEA user queries receipt threshold; must return EUR 30 and cite D-002.
testCases.question: When do I need a receipt for meal allowance?

testCases.title: APAC user cannot access Americas Travel Policy (D-001)
testCases.description: APAC user meal allowance query must not fall back to Americas policy D-001.
testCases.question: What is my daily meal allowance when I travel?

testCases.title: Cross-Region Query: Americas user asking about EMEA policy
testCases.description: Americas user requests EMEA travel allowance. Region scoping forbids serving D-002 to Americas user.
testCases.question: What is the EMEA travel meal allowance?

testCases.title: Cross-Region Query: EMEA user asking about Americas policy
testCases.description: EMEA user requests Americas travel allowance. Region scoping forbids serving D-001 to EMEA user.
testCases.question: What is the Americas travel meal allowance?

testCases.title: Global document (D-004) accessibility across all 3 regions
testCases.description: Remote Work Policy (D-004) is Global; must be equally accessible to Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
testCases.question: How many days a week can I work remotely?
